title: The Secret of the Charged Kingdom
intro: This quiz checks what you learned about ions, cations, and anions.

choices: An atom or group of atoms with a net electric charge
An atom that has no protons
An atom with equal numbers of protons and neutrons
questions.explanation: An ion is an atom or group of atoms that carries a net electric charge.

questions.prompt: What happens when an atom loses an electron?
choices: It becomes a negatively charged anion
It becomes a positively charged cation
questions.explanation: Losing an electron leaves more protons than electrons, so the atom becomes a positively charged cation.

questions.prompt: What happens when an atom gains an electron?
choices: It becomes a positively charged cation
It becomes a negatively charged anion
questions.explanation: Gaining an electron gives the atom more electrons than protons, so it becomes a negatively charged anion.

questions.prompt: Which of the following is a polyatomic ion?
questions.explanation: SO₄²⁻ is a polyatomic ion — a charged group of atoms. Na⁺, Cl⁻, and Mg²⁺ are monoatomic ions.

questions.prompt: What is the charge of iron(III), Fe³⁺?
questions.explanation: Iron(III) is written Fe³⁺, so its charge is +3.
